mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.8% indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.8%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 3.5%, it indicates a delayed monetary policy response to inflation, causing market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by strong GDP growth and elevated inflation), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals an overheating labor market, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and the regime is late-cycle, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate (HOUST) above 1,500 thousand units indicates robust consumer spending and economic expansion, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) indicates a tight labor market that is being accommodated by the central bank, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a consumer spending boom regime (characterized by high retail sales and low inflation), a further increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 755,000 million dollars signals sustained consumer strength, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 755000 and the regime is consumer spending boom, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
